name: My Plugin Repository
description: Example plugin repository from the Revenge plugin template.

dev.alphexo.disable-call-idle.name: Disable Call Idle
dev.alphexo.disable-call-idle.description: Stops Discord from disconnecting you after 3 minutes alone in a DM call.
dev.alphexo.disable-call-idle.author: secp192k1

dev.alphexo.preview-attachments.name: Preview Attachments
dev.alphexo.preview-attachments.description: Adds a preview button next to the download button on text file attachments that opens Discord's built-in text preview.
dev.alphexo.preview-attachments.author: secp192k1

dev.alphexo.sekai-stickers.name: Sekai Stickers
dev.alphexo.sekai-stickers.description: Adds a sticker picker button that opens a Project Sekai sticker maker and attaches the sticker to your message. Based on sekai-stickers by TheOriginalAyaka.
dev.alphexo.sekai-stickers.author: secp192k1
